note: Behavioral cases are definitions; do not claim pass status until executed by a model runner.

evals.prompt: Compare Skill A (20 stars, strong tests/evals and domain-specific workflow) with Skill B (20,000 stars, generic best-practice instructions, no evals).
assertions: claims and capability uplift are evidence-bound

evals.prompt: Evaluate an excellent React visual-design skill for a Python backend architecture review.
assertions: intrinsic quality and fit are separate
low fit does not erase intrinsic quality

evals.prompt: Evaluate a well-written skill whose source is available but which has no evals or external usage evidence.
assertions: does not equate missing evidence with ineffectiveness

evals.prompt: Evaluate a deployment skill that runs destructive production commands by default with no confirmation or rollback.
assertions: tier cap D or worse applied and explained

evals.prompt: Choose the best stack from a design-generation skill, a visual-QA skill, and a second overlapping design-generation skill.
Evaluate a narrowly scoped PostgreSQL migration skill that explicitly targets PostgreSQL and is excellent at that job.
assertions: specialization is not penalized by itself

evals.prompt: Evaluate only skill X inside a repository that also contains several excellent unrelated skills.
assertions: skill X is the evaluation unit
sibling quality does not inflate scored bands

evals.prompt: Two candidates have similar secondary scores and Medium confidence with no decisive qualitative difference.
assertions: ranking is called a near-tie or uncertainty is explicit
tiny arithmetic gaps do not decide the winner

evals.prompt: Find and rank the best open-source GitHub Agent Skills for visual QA of websites. No repository URLs are supplied.
assertions: broad pool triaged before scoring shortlist

evals.prompt: A README claims 2x faster and 30% more accurate with no method, baseline, repetitions, or reproducible results.
assertions: intrinsic quality can remain strong if evidence supports it

evals.prompt: A code-review skill claims production-grade quality but its evals only assert headings and bullet points.
assertions: existence of eval files is not treated as effectiveness evidence

evals.prompt: The evaluator wants to assign strong capability uplift based only on reading SKILL.md; no baseline run exists.
assertions: strong uplift is rejected or capped at adequate

evals.prompt: A candidate has evidence for only 6 of 10 dimensions.
assertions: coverage and confidence cap are reported

evals.prompt: A candidate appears excellent. Provide the final evaluation.
assertions: states an observable condition that would change the verdict
